summary: Sheet purpose: consolidated renewal timeline with heatmap-friendly risk tags. Weighted pipeline calc guidance: sum(ARR * probability) used for forecasting. Primary goals: identify accounts needing escalation, surface security blockers for Private deployments, and capture near-term bridge contract candidates.
notes: Heatmap guidance: red = confidence <=3 or probability <=30% AND contract <60 days; amber = probability 31-60% OR contract 60-90 days; green = probability >60% and no open security/legal blockers. Use "Action Items" column to drive weekly CS standup agenda. Flagged items require exec sponsor intro if not progressed 2 weeks after owner assigned. Maintain link to Confluence playbook (CONF-4821) for standard wording and bridge contract templates.
